findings.currentFirstPartyNetwork: Sagelio states 400+ charging points and gives site owners pricing control in one platform.
findings.directPayment: First-party Sagelio documentation states network-wide QR direct card payment through Electromaps: scan QR, choose card, connector, Activate with direct payment; EUR100 preauthorisation; charged consumption only.
findings.directPriceSemantics: Sagelio explicitly states direct card payment costs the same as Electromaps plus Stripe commission. This is a direct-payment route but the current connector-level Electromaps base price and Stripe fee must be captured deterministically before ranking.
findings.pricingVariability: Current first-party Sagelio pricing guidance says there is no tariff valid for all sites; 0.59 EUR/kWh is an example, not a network tariff.
findings.punEvidence: Exact current IT*SAG examples inspected in PUN-derived pages report tariffs not communicated to PUN.

blockingCondition: Exact IT*SAG QR/Electromaps direct-payment connector payload with current base tariff plus Stripe commission, mapped deterministically to PUN EVSE. Do not use 0.59 EUR/kWh example or generic Electromaps roaming price.
antiStagnation: Generic web tariff search is bounded. Resume only from exact IT*SAG QR/payment URL, Electromaps guest/direct-payment backend, or new first-party connector tariff evidence.
